lesson.menu_desc: You know every word and still catch nothing when somebody speaks at full speed. Tonight, the four things that disappear -- and what you say to get them back
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 9 -- Understanding Fast English
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ana Claudia Veraldi | Lesson 9 -- Understanding Fast English

listenings.text: Hey, it is me, sorry, I am walking, I am gonna be quick. So the ninth is locked in, I land at ten forty in the morning, and I gotta stay in the city that first night because of the car. Friday I am all yours. I wanna do the market thing you told me about, and after that, whatever you want, I am not gonna plan it. Two things though. One, I do not eat fish, I know, I am the worst. Two, my phone is gonna be useless out there, so if I do not answer, it is nothing personal. Lemme know if Friday still works and I will book the car tonight. Talk soon.

Hello Ana, this is Camille. I am sending you a voice message because it is easier for me than writing. I arrive on the tenth, one day after Todd, and I will take the bus, so you do not need to come and collect me. On Saturday I would like to see the market as well, and in the afternoon I am happy to do whatever you decide. There is one thing I must tell you. I go to bed extremely early, so if we go out at night, I will disappear before midnight. Please do not take it personally. Send me a message when you have time and tell me if Saturday is convenient for you. Thank you very much.
